title: LongHorizonUI: A Unified Framework for Robust Long-Horizon Task Automation of GUI Agent
authors: Bin Kang; Shaoguo Wen; Yifei Bi; Shunlong Wu; Xinbin Yuan; Rui Shao; Junle Wang; Zhuotao Tian
abstract: LongHorizonUI is an ICLR 2026 GUI-agent framework for robust long-horizon task automation. It introduces LongGUIBench and combines enhanced perception, structured reflective decision making, compensatory action execution, progress monitoring, and rollback for long-horizon GUI tasks.
